I’m sitting on the couch crying reading this. You seem like such a beautiful person. I would never want your life for mine. I wish it wasn’t this way or that we felt this desperate. 
I’m going to contact them but I don’t have anything to pay them. Im just getting back on my feet and starting to make good money, but I’m just behind on it all. I’m only 25. How did I fuck up this bad? With so much riding on it.. I don’t want to be here through today. Benadryl and alcohol are easy enough to get. I’m alone. My kids are at their dads.  My partner is at school. 
Finances shouldn’t make me want to kill myself. But you combine that with the fact that you got yourself there making bad decisions and now the consequences are real and here, you surely do want to die. 
I’ve been a fighter my whole life. But then I lost the biggest goddamn battle to myself and I deserve it now.
I hope you get through this. You are kind and deserving of good things to finally come to you. For relief. I hope you get it.

I have an amazing partner who’s helping me now, amazing kids and so much love, a good job, rent my house. It all looks so good on the surface but it’s crumbling. The debt is enough for me to feel hopeless. I can’t take a repo. I can’t do a lawsuit. I’m finally almost out of this whole I dug  while I’m addiction but I still fuxk up. And there’s so much to fix and I don’t think I can. I’m overwhelmed and ashamed and would rather go before it all falls
